我已经获取了所有必要材料，下面逐一回答三个问题。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 本季度收入同比增长百分比及计算过程

**原始数据**（来源：`financial_statements.txt` → "Segment Results" 工作表）：

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入 |
|---|---|
| Q4 FY26（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日三个月） | **$39,306 million** |
| Q4 FY25（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日三个月） | **$29,878 million** |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} \times 100\% = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \times 100\% \approx 31.55\%$$

四舍五入后为 **32%**，与财报新闻稿（`press_release.txt`）中披露的"Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"一致。

> 另注：`metrics.txt` 中 Azure and other cloud services revenue growth (y/y) 显示为 **43% / 43%**（GAAP / Constant Currency），这是 Intelligent Cloud 分部内的子项目增速，不是整个分部的增速。

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上将增长归因于哪些因素（引用原话）

以下为 Amy Hood（首席财务官）在 prepared remarks 中对 Intelligent Cloud 分部 Q4 业绩的归因分析（来源：`transcript.txt`）：

### (a) Azure 部分（占分部主体）

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** **That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

### (b) On-premises server 部分

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

### (c) 毛利率/运营层面的补充说明

> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by **sales mix shift to Azure**, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by **ongoing efficiency gains in Azure.** Segment margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."

---

## 3. 归因中哪些是已发生的事实，哪些是前瞻性表述

### ✅ 已发生的事实（描述 Q4 FY26 实际发生的事情）

| 归因因素 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| **(1) 客户需求持续超过可用产能** | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"——这是对 Q4 期间供需状态的描述。 |
| **(2) CPU/GPU 集群的效率提升** | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"——描述本季度已实现的效率改善成果。 |
| **(3) 流程改进使新产能更早交付** | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity"——描述本季度已完成的流程优化。 |
| **(4) 季度内新增产能被快速变现** | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized"——描述本季度已经发生的变现行为。 |
| **(5) GitHub Copilot 消费超出预期** | "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change"——6 月已完成商业模式变更，Q4 已产生实际消费数据。 |
| **(6) On-premises server 的续约带来更高当期收入确认** | "Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"——已完成的续约交易。 |
| **(7) 销售结构向 Azure 转移** | "sales mix shift to Azure"——这是 Q4 已发生的结构性变化。 |

**判断依据**：以上所有表述均以过去时态或现在完成时态描述 Q4 FY26（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三个月）内已经发生的事件或已实现的结果，不涉及对未来业绩的预测或期望。

### ⏭ 前瞻性表述（管理层对未来期间的展望/预期）

在本次电话会的归因讨论中，**直接的归因因素本身全部是回顾性事实**。但以下相关内容属于前瞻性表述（来源：`transcript.txt` 中 Amy Hood 的 Outlook 部分）：

> "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency and we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply."

> "Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."

> "And as a reminder, year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix."

> "we continue to expect FY27 capital expenditures will grow year-over-year given demand signals across our portfolio."

**判断依据**：这些表述使用了 "we expect"、"we continue to expect"、"remain focused on" 等预测性措辞，明确指向 FY27 Q1 及上半年的未来业绩预期，属于前瞻性表述（forward-looking statements）。电话会开头 Jonathan Neilson 也明确提示："During this call, we will be making forward-looking statements which are predictions, projections, or other statements about future events."

### ⚠️ 模糊地带需注意

"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" 这句话中的 "continues" 既是对当前状态的描述（事实），也暗含对未来供需关系的预期。但就 Q4 归因而言，它是作为已观察到的 Q4 期间的状态来引用的，因此归因语境下应视为事实陈述。其前瞻性含义体现在后续的展望部分（"we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"）。

---

**总结**：管理层对 Intelligent Cloud Q4 32% 增长的归因因素——需求超过供给、效率提升、流程改进、产能快速变现、GitHub Copilot 消费超预期、on-premises server 续约结构——均为对已发生事实的描述。电话会中的前瞻性表述独立于归因分析，集中在 Outlook 部分，涉及 FY27 Q1 及未来的增速预期和资本开支计划。
